adds.title: Suriname Court of Appeal - January 2022 ruling
adds.summary: On 21 January 2022 Suriname's Hof van Justitie granted official recognition of gender change to Yvanna Paris Simpson, establishing a court-based precedent allowing transgender persons to seek amendment of sex and name on birth certificates and official registers, with execution via the Ministry of Interior Affairs still sought and comprehensive self-determination legislation to allow change without lengthy, degrading treatment still lacking.
